ns2:course.label: Intro to Human Nutrition
ns2:course.description: Introductory course for students in Human Nutrition. Explore department, college and campus resources. Learn about current issues, opportunities, and careers in the nutrition field. Prerequisite: Restricted to students majoring in Nutrition and Health, BS.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: Restricted to students majoring in Nutrition and Health, BS.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to BS:F Sc&Hum Nutrition-HN -UIUC or BS:Nutrition & Health - UIUC.
